datasets.name: Landslide images in Bijie City
datasets.verbatim: In this experiment, more than 200 high-quality landslide images containing large, medium and small landslides were selected from the landslide images and labeled using the Labelimg tool to form a training dataset in PASCAL VOC format...In this experiment, we use landslide image in Bijie City[6].

datasets.name: TripleSat satellite imagery
datasets.verbatim: the landslide images used in the experiments in this paper are taken by TripleSat satellites.

datasets.name: 18-layer satellite image slices of Yingxiu town
datasets.verbatim: The 18-layer satellite image slices of Yingxiu town were downloaded by bigemap software

methods.name: Efficient Residual Channel Attention Mechanism Network (ERCA)
methods.summary: ERCA is a channel attention mechanism that uses 1D convolution to capture cross-channel interactions, a soft thresholding layer to eliminate unimportant features, and a residual connection to sum the re-assigned features with the original input. It is integrated into the backbone of the Faster R-CNN model to improve feature extraction and reduce background noise.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory and other input datasets are mentioned but not linked or made available. The custom code for the ERCA method is provided via a GitHub repository link.
